build_CSRA_cls_head: build a CSRA classifier head with configurable num_heads and temperature settings for multi-label recognition
create_CSRA_module: create a CSRAModule with temperature T and lambda for class-specific residual attention computation
run_forward_CSRA_head: run the forward pass of CSRAClsHead on backbone feature tuples to get classification logits
review_pre_logits_method: review the pre_logits method that extracts the last stage feature from backbone output tuples
test_temperature_settings: test the temperature_settings dictionary to verify valid num_heads values of 1, 2, 4, 6, or 8
